title: Cinnamon Banana Protein Pancakes
description: Blended oat pancakes with banana, eggs and whey, served with cool yogurt and berries.
ingredients: 100 g plain skyr and berries, to serve
steps: Blend the oats, banana, eggs, protein powder, baking powder and cinnamon.
Cook small rounds in a non-stick pan for 1-2 minutes per side.
Stack with skyr and fresh berries.

source.label: Adapted from Good Food protein pancakes

notes: Banana's fast carbs plus whey's fast protein make this a good pre-workout choice if you're training within two hours.
